# Handwritten converter examples

Synthetic test data only: three banks, nine financial examples, three ratings,
six aliases and six service examples. Figures and quotes are deliberately made
up for unit tests and must never be loaded as real bank information. URLs identify
public bank homepages only; they do not substantiate these synthetic values.

No scraped articles, article bodies, source files or collection metadata are
included. Empty news/link files test the supported no-news case. The public
converter defaults and production loader still require all nine configured banks.
